parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of the tunnel.

parameters.name: RemoteEndpoints
parameters.description: The Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) or IP address of the remote VXLAN tunnel endpoint. If more than one name/address is supplied, they will be tried in turn, i.e. they are in decreasing order of precedence.

parameters.name: KeepAlivePolicy
parameters.description: The mechanism used to keep the tunnel from timing out at the {{param|ConnectedRemoteEndpoint}}.

parameters.name: KeepAliveThreshold
parameters.description: Number of KeepAlive messages unacknowledged by the {{param|ConnectedRemoteEndpoint}} before the {{object}} is perceived failed.

parameters.name: DeliveryHeaderProtocol
parameters.description: The protocol used for the delivery header.

parameters.name: DefaultDSCPMark
parameters.description: If the specified entries in the {{object|#.Filter}} table do not match this {{object}} object or an instance of the {{object|Interface}} object for this {{object}} object, then the value of this parameter is applied to the delivery header of the packets in this {{object}}.

parameters.name: ConnectedRemoteEndpoint
parameters.description: The Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) name or IP address of the connected remote VXLAN tunnel endpoint.

parameters.name: SourcePort
parameters.description: The source (local) port used to transmit PDUs. A value of 0 indicates that the port selection is performed by the device. In such case, it is recommended that the UDP source port number be calculated using a hash of fields from the inner packet and that it is in the dynamic/private port range 49152-65535.

parameters.name: RemotePort
parameters.description: The remote port used to by the remote endpoint to transmit PDUs. The well-known port allocated by IANA is 4789, but it should be configurable.

object.description: VXLAN Tunnel table, models the VXLAN Tunnel instance and represents the entry point and exit point of the tunnel in relation to the WAN interface. A {{object}} object has one or more {{object|Interface}} objects that further define the sessions or flows within the tunnel.
